name: The Root Pizza
shortDescription: San Marzano tomatoes, fior di latte and fresh basil on our 48-hour dough.
description: The essential foundation. Hand-crushed San Marzano DOP tomatoes, creamy fior di latte mozzarella and torn basil on a 48-hour fermented Neapolitan crust, finished with a ribbon of cold-pressed extra-virgin olive oil. Clean, minimal and perfectly balanced: the architecture of pure flavor.
imageAlt: The Root Pizza: Margherita with San Marzano tomato, melted fior di latte and fresh basil leaves.

name: Boolean Pepperoni
shortDescription: Double-layer cup-and-char pepperoni with a hot honey glaze.
description: A binary choice that always returns true. Two layers of cup-and-char pepperoni that crisp into little bowls of flavor, fior di latte and San Marzano sauce, finished with a drizzle of chili-infused wildflower hot honey and a pinch of Sicilian oregano.
imageAlt: Boolean Pepperoni: pepperoni pizza with crisp curled pepperoni cups and a glossy hot honey drizzle.

name: SQL Supreme
shortDescription: Fennel sausage, mushrooms, peppers, red onion and olives.
description: Complex queries for complex palates. Fennel Italian sausage, cremini mushrooms, green bell pepper, red onion and Taggiasca olives over San Marzano sauce and fior di latte, seasoned with Sicilian oregano. Every join returns something delicious.
imageAlt: SQL Supreme: supreme pizza with sausage, mushrooms, green peppers, red onion and black olives.

name: Binary BBQ
shortDescription: Smoked pulled pork, caramelized onions and smoked provolone on hickory BBQ sauce.
description: Low and slow meets hot and fast. Hickory-smoked pulled pork shoulder, sweet caramelized onions, sharp red onion and smoked provolone on a smoky BBQ base with fior di latte, finished with fresh basil and a blistered, leopard-spotted rim.
imageAlt: Binary BBQ: Neapolitan pizza with pulled pork, caramelized onions and fresh basil on a dark slate.

name: Inferno Payload
shortDescription: Spicy spianata calabrese, fresh jalapeños and buffalo mozzarella with Calabrian chili oil.
description: Deploy with caution: this payload runs hot. Spicy spianata calabrese salami, fresh jalapeño coins and creamy buffalo mozzarella over San Marzano sauce, finished with Calabrian chili oil and crushed red pepper.
imageAlt: Inferno Payload: spicy pizza with salami, jalapeño slices, buffalo mozzarella and chili flakes.

name: Kernel Panic Meat
shortDescription: Pepperoni, fennel sausage, smoked bacon and Italian ham.
description: Four protein threads, zero deadlocks. Cup-and-char pepperoni, fennel Italian sausage, applewood-smoked bacon and prosciutto cotto layered over San Marzano sauce and fior di latte, with a dusting of oregano. Built for serious appetites.
imageAlt: Kernel Panic Meat: meat lovers pizza loaded with pepperoni, sausage, bacon and ham.

name: Truffle Kernel
shortDescription: Black truffle cream, porcini and cremini mushrooms, cool stracciatella.
description: A white pizza for the winter release. Black truffle cream instead of tomato, roasted porcini and cremini mushrooms and fior di latte, finished after the bake with spoonfuls of cool, milky stracciatella and a few drops of black truffle oil.
imageAlt: Truffle Kernel: white pizza with roasted mushrooms and dollops of stracciatella.

name: Quad-Core Formaggi
shortDescription: Four cheeses, no sauce: mozzarella, gorgonzola, fontina and aged hard cheese.
description: Four cores running in parallel. A bianca base of fior di latte, creamy gorgonzola dolce, nutty fontina and a vegetarian parmesan-style hard cheese, baked until bubbling and finished with extra-virgin olive oil. Rich, savory and perfectly multithreaded.
imageAlt: Quad-Core Formaggi: golden four-cheese pizza with melted pools of gorgonzola.

name: The Clean Code
shortDescription: Grilled zucchini, roasted eggplant, peppers and cherry tomatoes.
description: Readable, maintainable and full of vegetables. Grilled zucchini, roasted eggplant, roasted red peppers, sweet cherry tomatoes and red onion over San Marzano sauce and fior di latte, finished with fresh basil. No technical debt, just flavor.
imageAlt: The Clean Code: vegetable pizza with grilled zucchini, eggplant, red peppers and cherry tomatoes.

name: Low-Mem Garden
shortDescription: Yellow tomato, cashew mozzarella, artichokes, olives and arugula. 100 % plant-based.
description: Small footprint, full performance. Sweet yellow datterini tomato sauce and melty cashew mozzarella topped with marinated artichoke hearts, Taggiasca olives and cherry tomatoes, finished with dollops of lemony cashew ricotta, wild arugula and extra-virgin olive oil. Entirely plant-based.
imageAlt: Low-Mem Garden: vegan pizza with yellow tomato, artichokes, olives and fresh arugula.

name: Hawaiian Legacy Fix
shortDescription: Italian ham, roasted pineapple and a jalapeño patch.
description: Legacy code that still ships, now with a hotfix. Prosciutto cotto and caramelized roasted pineapple over San Marzano sauce and fior di latte, patched with a few fresh jalapeño slices for a sweet-and-heat balance.
imageAlt: Hawaiian Legacy Fix: ham and pineapple pizza with a few green jalapeño slices.

name: Calzone Container
shortDescription: Folded and sealed: ricotta, mozzarella, Italian ham and mushrooms.
description: Everything packaged in one portable container. Our Neapolitan dough folded around whole-milk ricotta, fior di latte, prosciutto cotto, cremini mushrooms and fresh basil, baked until golden and served with San Marzano sauce baked inside.
imageAlt: Calzone Container: golden folded calzone, cut open to show ricotta, ham and mushrooms.

name: Garlic Knot Loop
shortDescription: Six garlic-butter knots with parmesan-style cheese and marinara for dipping.
description: Six hand-tied knots of our pizza dough, baked golden, tossed in garlic butter, parsley and parmesan-style cheese, with San Marzano marinara for dipping. An infinite loop you will not want to break.
imageAlt: Garlic Knot Loop: six golden garlic knots with parsley and a cup of marinara.

name: Caesar Cipher Salad
shortDescription: Romaine, shaved hard cheese and sourdough croutons in anchovy Caesar dressing.
description: Crisp romaine hearts, shaved parmesan-style cheese and sourdough croutons in a classic anchovy Caesar dressing. Decrypts to: delicious.
imageAlt: Caesar Cipher Salad: romaine, shaved hard cheese and sourdough croutons in Caesar dressing.

name: Hot Wings Webhook
shortDescription: Eight oven-roasted wings in a Calabrian chili and honey glaze, with blue cheese dip.
description: Eight crispy oven-roasted chicken wings glazed with Calabrian chili and honey, served with blue cheese dip and celery sticks. Fires on every bite.
imageAlt: Hot Wings Webhook: chili-glazed chicken wings with blue cheese dip and celery sticks.

name: Garlic Driver Dip
shortDescription: Roasted garlic and herb dip for crusts and knots.
description: Roasted garlic and herb emulsion. The essential driver for crusts and knots.
imageAlt: Garlic Driver Dip: a small cup of creamy roasted garlic and herb dip.

name: Jalapeño Patch Dip
shortDescription: Cool buttermilk ranch with fresh jalapeño and cilantro.
description: Cool buttermilk ranch with fresh jalapeño and cilantro. A gentle heat patch for any slice.
imageAlt: Jalapeño Patch Dip: a small cup of ranch dip with chopped jalapeño and cilantro.

name: Mate Compiler Tonic
shortDescription: Sparkling yerba mate with green tea and lime. Sugar-free.
description: Cold-brewed yerba mate with green tea and a squeeze of lime, lightly sparkling and sugar-free. Clean energy for long compile times.
imageAlt: Mate Compiler Tonic: a chilled can of sparkling yerba mate.

name: Cold Brew Commit
shortDescription: Single-origin Colombian coffee, cold-steeped for 18 hours. Unsweetened.
description: Single-origin Colombian coffee steeped cold for 18 hours. Smooth, chocolatey, unsweetened. Commit to the night shift.
imageAlt: Cold Brew Commit: a bottle of dark cold brew coffee.

name: Cola Cache
shortDescription: Ice-cold classic cola with cane sugar.
description: Ice-cold classic cola with cane sugar. Always a cache hit.
imageAlt: Cola Cache: an ice-cold can of classic cola.

name: Lemon Lint Soda
shortDescription: Sparkling Sicilian lemon soda, bright and not too sweet.
description: Sparkling Sicilian lemon soda, bright and not too sweet. Removes every warning from your palate.
imageAlt: Lemon Lint Soda: a bottle of sparkling Sicilian lemon soda.

name: Sparkling Stream Water
shortDescription: Naturally carbonated Italian mineral water.
description: Naturally carbonated Italian mineral water. Zero dependencies.
imageAlt: Sparkling Stream Water: a bottle of sparkling mineral water.

name: Tiramisu Stack
shortDescription: Espresso-soaked ladyfingers, whipped mascarpone and dark cocoa.
description: Espresso-soaked ladyfingers layered with whipped mascarpone and finished with dark cocoa. Every layer pushed in the right order.
imageAlt: Tiramisu Stack: a cup of layered tiramisu dusted with cocoa.

name: Cannoli Callback
shortDescription: Two crisp shells with sweet ricotta, chocolate chips and pistachios.
description: Two crisp Sicilian shells piped to order with sweet ricotta and chocolate chips, dipped in crushed pistachios. Called back the moment you finish.
imageAlt: Cannoli Callback: two ricotta-filled cannoli with pistachio-dipped ends.

name: Lava Exception Cake
shortDescription: Warm dark-chocolate cake with a molten center.
description: A warm dark-chocolate cake with a molten center that throws on the first spoonful. Handle with vanilla ice cream (not included).
imageAlt: Lava Exception Cake: a chocolate lava cake with a molten center.
